text:
jess: Heads-up — we keep seeing wide fanout of spans to multiple backends when tenant sampling = 100%. This is causing high ingest into Honeycomb and spikes in retention costs. Thoughts on routing policy?

matt: Can we change exporter pipeline to route by environment + service? e.g. dev -> honeycomb only, prod -> tempo+datadog, staging -> tempo. Right now we always fanout to all backends.

sophia: Prefer routing based on sampling decision plus attribute `redwood.route=full|lite` set by proxy. That way we can send full spans to Tempo for long-term retention and lite structs to Honeycomb for fast debug.

jess: Love that. How would it look in config?
matt: snippet:
```
exporters:
  honeycomb:
    send_if: 'resource.env != "prod" || attributes.redwood.route == "lite"'
  tempo:
    send_if: 'attributes.trace_retain == "true"'
```
sophia: Also need TTL on Tempo storage for tenant-scoped traces. Tempo retention is per-tenant bucket; ops can set `retention_days` in the tenant config. We should default to 30 for free tenants, 180 for paid.

ryan: Concern: duplication still doubles ingest cost if both get full spans. We should add an upstream filter to drop heavy attributes when sending to honeycomb: keep only `span.name`, `service`, `error`, `trace_id`, `sampled_flag`.

jess: Agreed. Also we need mapping for span->event conversion in Honeycomb to collapse high-cardinality attributes. Maybe add `attributes.redwood.hb_map` to map keys.

infra-bot: [deploy] telemetry-routing v0.6 started (sha abcd123)

sophia: Perf note — adding per-backend batching and TTL-aware cache avoids duplicate writes when sampler flips. Might reduce cost by ~18%.

matt: Action items:
- implement `send_if` conditional operators in otel collector (matt)
- add attribute scrubber for honeycomb (ryan)
- tenant default retention planner doc (sophia)
- add rollout plan + canary to 10% of tenants (jess)

jess: I'll file the rollout in the console as a toggle for Dedicated vs Hosted customers. :thumbsup:

ryan: If we need a quick rollback, set `telemetry-routing.enabled=false` in tenant config.

sophia: Let's sync tomorrow 10am.
